user.title: Connect your Tuya Cloud project
user.description: Enter your Tuya Cloud project credentials once. The integration checks several Tuya APIs to find compatible IR A/C controllers.

devices.title: Select IR air conditioners
devices.description: These devices were detected automatically as IR climate controllers. You can select more than one.

manual.title: Enter Device ID manually
manual.description: Automatic discovery could not identify the device with high confidence. Enter the Device ID of your IR A/C controller. The integration will continue with multi-API capability discovery and will automatically learn real IR commands from normal Tuya IoT Core logs.

error.cannot_connect: Tuya credentials are valid, but this Device ID could not be read. Check the Device ID, data center, and that the Smart Life/Tuya account is linked to this cloud project.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid Tuya Cloud credentials, data center, or authorization.
error.select_device: Select at least one detected device.
error.unknown: Unexpected setup error. Check Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Tuya Cloud project is already configured.
